raw_row_room.name: Raw Row Preservation Room

agents.claim: The literal sequence is preserved: hide, fake-help, room/dining/bag/bathroom, bar top reveal, pillows.
The carousel can be understood with text hidden because object movement drives the story.

raw_row_room.summary: The concept is approved only as the raw creator row, not as a rewritten phone/remote or phone-pocket concept.
debate_records: Rejected abstraction, second objects, and thesis-first copy.

selected_outputs.winner: Phone Prank Search Party Raw Row

exploration_routes.name: Phone Prank Search Party Raw Row
exploration_routes.story_lens: A tiny prank becomes a real couple issue when fake-helping stretches too long.
exploration_routes.reader_mirror: Every couple has one person who creates tiny nonsense and then has to survive the consequences.
exploration_routes.emotional_obstacle: A harmless prank can cross into irritation when the other person has genuinely searched everywhere.
exploration_routes.aachu_specific_spark: She searches the room, dining, bag, and bathroom before realizing he did it.
exploration_routes.zuv_active_role: He actively hides the phone, performs concern, and then returns it on the bar top when she gets angry.
exploration_routes.proof_engine: Literal object movement: hidden phone, house-wide search, bar-top reveal, pillow throw.
exploration_routes.emotional_reversal: The annoyance turns into pillow punishment and laughter.
exploration_routes.payoff: Safe daily-life mischief: he can tease her, but consequences arrive immediately.
exploration_routes.distribution_reason: Couples send it because it names the real home prank dynamic without moralizing it.

stage_scene_gate.action: Zuv hides Aachu phone, fake-helps search, then returns it on the bar top.
stage_scene_gate.reaction: Aachu moves from normal searching to annoyance, then realizes he did it.
stage_scene_gate.eye_line_or_attention: Her attention moves through room, dining, bag, bathroom, then lands on his hand putting the phone on the bar top.
stage_scene_gate.hands_or_object_movement: Phone moves from her world to his hidden control to the bar top; pillow moves toward him as consequence.
stage_scene_gate.silence_or_pause: The caught beat happens when she looks from phone to him before the pillow throw.
stage_scene_gate.consequence: His prank receives playful pillow punishment, not a romantic quote.
stage_scene_gate.reversal_or_payoff: He hid the phone; he finds the pillows. Both laugh.
